sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4682 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against him, in FIR No.562 of 2019, on the file of Nallapadu Police Station,
Guntur Urban.
The offences alleged are under Sections 270, 273, 284 IPC and under Sections 58 and 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Heard Sri Rajareddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No. 562 of 2019, on the file of Nallapadu Police Station, Guntur Urban, for the offences under Sections 270, 273, 284 IPC and under Sections 58 and 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act-2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date:06.08.2019 Ssv HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU CRIMINAL PETITION No.4682 of 2019 Date:06.08.2019 ssv Kunduru Ramakrishna vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 6 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196027750/
